primary_penal_code: Theft Act 1968 & Offences Against Person Act 1861

statutes.title: Basic Definition of Theft
statutes.description: A person is guilty of theft if he dishonestly appropriates property belonging to another with the intention of permanently depriving the other of it.
statutes.penalty: Maximum penalty on indictment: 7 years imprisonment.

statutes.title: Burglary of Domestic or Commercial Building
statutes.description: A person is guilty of burglary if he enters any building or part of a building as a trespasser with intent to commit theft or grievous bodily harm.
statutes.penalty: Maximum penalty for domestic burglary: 14 years imprisonment.

statutes.act_name: Matrimonial Causes Act 1973 (as amended by Divorce, Dissolution & Separation Act 2020)
statutes.title: Divorce on No-Fault Irretrievable Breakdown
statutes.description: Application for divorce stating irretrievable breakdown of marriage without requirement to prove marital fault.

statutes.title: Unfair Prejudice Petition by Shareholder
statutes.description: A member of a company may apply to court by petition for an order on the ground that the company's affairs are being conducted in a manner unfairly prejudicial to the interests of members.
